title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Deligne working record: standardized papers 001-014p030, 081-090, and correspondence readers
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing. Individual English paper PDFs, selected French source/working PDFs, and separate correspondence items are exposed for direct download. Broader reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. [#######---] active touched-paper stream: working paper-level translations and French source layers are present for selected Deligne papers, including a sequential source-checked block for papers 001-013 complete and paper 014 through page 30; [########--] correspondence stream: Deligne letters and letter sections are available in English with paired French working PDFs where supplied; [##########] original/reference and provenance material is preserved in ZIP artifacts. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Latest update. Advanced the source-checked sequential Deligne paper block to papers 001-013 complete plus paper 014 through page 30, exposed individual reader PDFs for paper 006, and replaced the compact TeX/scan/QA source packet with the p030 packet.
